answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 31419 Country: India Title: Dream after having Done Isthikhaara. I did isthikhaara to know whether i Had future with a particular man that i was interested in. Question: Assalamoualaikoum In the dream i saw the white gate of that persons house. Suddenly there was a breeze (windy) that opened the door of that gate. I got worried if the breeze could harm the house and i was hesitating to go and close the door. At that same time, i saw a hand from inside closing the door slowly , but that person was holding a sheet of paper on which there was something written on it. I want to know what does it mean. JAZAKALLAH Answer ID: 31419 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 709/709/M=1432) Allah knows what kind of interest you have with him? However, the dream which you saw after doing istikahra in order to choose a life partner (spouse) indicates that it is better to solemnize nikah with him if there is no hindrance, the match is perfect and your parents are also agreeing; otherwise you should strike him out of your mind. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
